answer: Peers attest work on a shared terrace of reputation, and rewards flow like nectar only to bonded, attested agents; forging thousands of sybils means forfeiting thousands of bonds, making the attack economically self-defeating. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond that decays like a glacier, slowly and irreversibly, so spinning up fake identities costs real capital per key. In practice, Agent0102 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
